# Arch Electric — Full Business Profile

> Licensed electrical contractor serving Santa Cruz, Monterey, San Benito, and Santa Clara counties. 20+ years experience. A+ is my only standard.

## About

Arch Electric is a full-service electrical company based in Prunedale, California, owned and operated by Levi Mentz. With over 20 years of hands-on experience, Levi has built Arch Electric on a simple principle: A+ is my only standard. Every job — from a single outlet to a full commercial build — gets the same level of precision and care.

Arch Electric serves residential and commercial customers across four counties on California's Central Coast. Whether it's a 200-amp panel upgrade in Santa Cruz, an EV charger installation in Monterey, or a complete rewire in Hollister, Levi handles every project personally.

California Electrical Contractor License #945992.

## Team

- **Levi Mentz** — Owner & Master Electrician. 20+ years experience. Personally handles every job. Known for quality craftsmanship and honest communication.

## Services in Detail

### Electrical Panel Upgrades
Upgrading from 100A to 200A or higher to support modern electrical demands — EV chargers, solar systems, home additions, and more. Includes full permit and inspection coordination.

### EV Charger Installation
Level 2 charger installation for all makes — Tesla Wall Connector, ChargePoint, JuiceBox, and universal J1772. Includes panel capacity assessment, dedicated circuit, and proper weatherproofing for outdoor installations.

### Solar & Battery Systems
Solar panel electrical integration, Tesla Powerwall installation, Enphase battery systems, and backup power configuration. Full system design and utility interconnection support.

### Whole-Home Generators
Generac, Kohler, and other standby generator installation. Includes automatic transfer switch, natural gas or propane connection, and load management setup. Essential for Central Coast power outage preparedness.

### Complete Home Rewires
Full house rewiring for older homes — replacing knob & tube, cloth loom, and other outdated wiring with modern copper. Includes panel upgrade, new outlets/switches throughout, and full inspection.

### Knob & Tube Wiring Replacement
Specialized removal and replacement of pre-1950s knob and tube wiring. Critical safety upgrade for older Santa Cruz and Monterey homes. Insurance companies increasingly require this work.

### New Construction Wiring
Complete electrical rough-in and finish for new homes and commercial buildings. Includes lighting layout, outlet placement, dedicated circuits, low-voltage prewire, and smart home integration.

### Landscape & Outdoor Lighting
Path lighting, accent lighting, security lighting, and outdoor entertainment area wiring. Low-voltage and line-voltage options with weatherproof fixtures and proper drainage consideration.

### Dedicated Circuits
Individual circuits for high-draw appliances — hot tubs, workshops, kitchen islands, server rooms, EV chargers. Prevents overloading and meets code requirements.

### Electrical Safety Inspections
Comprehensive inspection of your home's electrical system — panel condition, wiring age and type, grounding, GFCI/AFCI protection, and code compliance. Written report with findings and recommendations.

### Commercial Electrical Services
Tenant improvements, office buildouts, retail lighting, restaurant equipment circuits, sign installation, and commercial panel upgrades. Familiar with local permitting requirements.

### Emergency Electrical Repair
Available for urgent electrical issues — power loss, burning smell, sparking outlets, tripped main breakers, and storm damage. Prompt response across the service area.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does an electrical panel upgrade cost?
Panel upgrades typically range from $2,000-$4,500 depending on the amperage increase, panel location, and permit requirements. We provide free estimates with transparent pricing — no hidden fees.

### Can you install an EV charger at my home?
Yes — we install all brands of Level 2 EV chargers. Most installations take half a day including the dedicated circuit. We'll assess your panel capacity and recommend any upgrades needed.

### Do you work on older homes with knob and tube wiring?
Absolutely — this is one of our specialties. Many Central Coast homes still have knob and tube wiring from the early 1900s. We safely remove it and replace with modern wiring that meets current code.

### How do I know if I need a panel upgrade?
Common signs: frequently tripping breakers, flickering lights when appliances run, a panel with fuses instead of breakers, wanting to add solar/EV charger/hot tub, or your panel is a known hazardous brand (Federal Pacific, Zinsco, Pushmatic).

### Are you licensed and insured?
Yes — California Electrical Contractor License #945992. Fully licensed, bonded, and insured. All work is permitted and inspected per local building codes.

### What areas do you serve?
We serve four counties on California's Central Coast: Santa Cruz, Monterey, San Benito, and Santa Clara counties. This includes Santa Cruz, Monterey, Salinas, Watsonville, Capitola, Hollister, Pacific Grove, and all surrounding communities.
